item.title: Recovery Under Way as Communities Begin to Emerge From Severe Weather
item.description: Recovery is under way across northern Scotland as severe weather eases, with transport links reopening, schools working towards a return, and resilience partners focusing support on communities most affected by recent snow and ice.The post Recovery Under Way as Communities Begin to Emerge From Severe Weather appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Hospitality Tech Firm Secures Major US Partnership to Help Hotels Cut Booking Fees
item.description: An Inverness-founded hospitality tech firm has secured a major US partnership designed to help hotels boost direct bookings, cut commission costs, and retain control of customer data in an increasingly competitive online market.The post Highland Hospitality Tech Firm Secures Major US Partnership to Help Hotels Cut Booking Fees appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Ambulance Staff Face Daily Violence as Abuse Rises Across The Country
item.description: Ambulance crews across Scotland are facing daily violence while responding to emergencies, with new figures showing a rise in assaults on staff and warnings that abuse is driving experienced workers out of the service.The post Scottish Ambulance Staff Face Daily Violence as Abuse Rises Across The Country appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: £10m Emergency Support Boost for Families as Child Poverty Funding Reallocated
item.description: £10 million is being redirected to provide emergency support for families facing hardship, with funding boosted for councils and children’s charities delivering urgent help to tackle child poverty across Scotland.The post £10m Emergency Support Boost for Families as Child Poverty Funding Reallocated appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: JAECOO Becomes UK’s Fastest-Growing Mainstream Car Brand in a Decade
item.description: JAECOO has become the UK’s fastest-growing mainstream car brand in a decade, registering over 28,000 vehicles in 2025 as strong demand for its hybrid and SUV models reshaped the market.The post JAECOO Becomes UK’s Fastest-Growing Mainstream Car Brand in a Decade appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Greens Welcome Fresh Push for Lynx Reintroduction in The Highlands
item.description: A new campaign is urging people to have their say on reintroducing lynx to the Highlands, with the Scottish Greens arguing the species could boost biodiversity, restore woodland and play a key role in tackling Scotland’s nature emergency.The post Greens Welcome Fresh Push for Lynx Reintroduction in The Highlands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Confidence in Labour Crashes to Record Low as Cost of Living Bites
item.description: Household finances are under intense pressure as a new poll shows public confidence in Labour’s handling of the cost of living has hit a record low, with rising energy bills and food prices driving growing concern across Scotland and beyond.The post Confidence in Labour Crashes to Record Low as Cost of Living Bites appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Dingwall Locals Get Creative Ahead of Bright Burgh Trail
item.description: Dingwall residents are lighting up the town this January as part of the Bright Burgh Trail, launching a year-long celebration of Dingwall 800 with illuminated windows, community art and a magical evening walk through the Royal Burgh.The post Dingwall Locals Get Creative Ahead of Bright Burgh Trail appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Inverness Councillors Move Closer to Short Term Let Control Areas
item.description: Inverness councillors have agreed to progress plans to consult on two Short Term Let Control Areas covering the city and surrounding rural communities, allowing public feedback on housing pressures linked to holiday lets.The post Inverness Councillors Move Closer to Short Term Let Control Areas appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Recovery Continues Across Highlands After Days of Severe Snow
item.description: Recovery is continuing across the Highlands as roads, ferries and airports return to normal after days of severe snow, with local road and rail impacts still being cleared and cold conditions expected to linger into the weekend.The post Recovery Continues Across Highlands After Days of Severe Snow appeared first on The Highland Times.
